name: Yoga school in Singapore
reason: No suitable school within the two-candidate limit. First candidate, Vyasa Yoga Singapore (vyasasingapore.com, founder Manoj Thakur, 25 years), is blocked: its robots.txt names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web with Disallow: / (10 Nov 2026), so nothing was fetched. Second candidate, Align Studio (alignstudio.sg, Ang Mo Kio), is a fitness-led studio (handstands, splits, 'science-backed' anatomy) whose only 200-hour training ran 5 Sep - 8 Nov 2026 with no future date published, so it fails both the spiritual-practice test and the current-training test. Wendy Chan's Yoga Seeds is already on Spiritpedia as an individual listing, so it was not considered.
